description: Defines classes and methods for decoding preloaded data entries, including bit and Huffman decoding, used in network data processing within Chromium project.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder
classes.description: Base class for decoding preloaded network data, including trie-based decoding and entry resolution.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::BitReader
classes.description: Provides bit-level reading capabilities from a byte stream.

classes.name: PreloadDecoder::HuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Handles Huffman tree decoding for compressed data.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Sets *out to the next bit from input; returns false if no bits are available.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the specified number of bits into *out; returns false if insufficient bits.

methods.name: DecodeSize
methods.description: Decodes a size_t value using a prefix code optimized for small values.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Sets the current bit offset in the input stream.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a search string in the preloaded trie data, indicating if a relevant entry is found.
